policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O acquires Orchestra Bio
items.summary: O announced it has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform for coordinating drug-development workflows. Potentially strengthens O’s biopharma tooling and accelerates partner experimentation in drug discovery and development operations.

items.headline: O plans profit-sharing model ahead of IPO wave
items.summary: AP reports executives at O and Anthropic discussing plans to share wealth as major AI IPOs approach. This is not a filing, but could affect future capital structure and public-market narrative.

items.headline: V has two spacecraft in orbit
items.summary: Space.com reports V is operating two spacecraft in orbit and expects additional launches soon plus a larger next-year cadence, supporting continued in-space manufacturing capacity ramp.
